jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Role Summary:

An established B2B and direct-to-consumer retail software provider is hiring a hands-on Chief Technology Officer. The company's mature point-of-sale and eCommerce platform, built on legacy Java and Swing, is central to how its customers run their businesses. Leadership is committed to modernizing it.

Reporting to the President, you'll own technology and product strategy, define the target architecture, and lead the move to AI-driven development across the engineering team. This is a player-coach role. You'll make architecture decisions, manage technical debt deliberately, and build a team that ships predictably. You'll also decide when to maintain what exists and when to rebuild it.

Role:
Chief Technology Officer
Client:
B2B and direct-to-consumer retail software provider
Location:
Remote
Duration:
Full Time Permanent

What You'll Own

Technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, DevOps, and software delivery
Product direction and roadmap prioritization aligned with commercial goals
Platform and eCommerce modernization, including migration off legacy Java and Swing, and the cloud roadmap
CI/CD, observability, and automation to support reliable weekly releases
Adoption of AI-assisted development (AI-DLC) as standard practice, plus disciplined evaluation of customer-facing AI opportunities

Cybersecurity, IT general controls, compliance, business continuity, and disaster recovery
Leadership of an approximately 14-person distributed engineering organization across internal, offshore, and partner resources
Regular engagement with the executive team and Board on modernization, investment, and technology risk

What Success Looks Like

First 60 days:
A full technology, product, and delivery assessment is complete. Modernization options are evaluated and leadership is aligned on priorities.
By 120 days:
The target architecture and a funded roadmap are approved. Release infrastructure is operating on a predictable weekly cadence. AI tooling is adopted across the team, and platform knowledge is documented and shared.
By 12 months:
Modernization progress is measurable, delivery is more predictable, the platform is more resilient, and there is a clear path to greater AI-DLC maturity.

What You Bring

Prior experience as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or in an equivalent executive technology role
15+ years in technology, including 10+ years leading software development teams

Hands-on experience modernizing legacy systems
, i deally a POS or eCommerce platform
, or a migration off Java and Swing

A track record of building CI/CD, observability, and automation in lean, resource-constrained environments
Experience leading distributed teams that include internal, offshore, and external partner resources
Executive oversight of cybersecurity, technology risk, and business continuity
The business fluency to connect engineering decisions to growth, margin, and customer impact

Nice to Have

Retail technology, point-of-sale, eCommerce, or payments experience

Experience in specialty, grocery, or regulated retail
AWS cloud modernization leadership
(Azure or Google Cloud experience will be considered)
Vertical SaaS, fintech, ERP, or other high-availability transaction environments

Interview Stages:

Virtual meeting with President
Technical Round Interview
Ideal Start Date December

How You Lead

You are a steady transformation leader. You make sound decisions with incomplete information and communicate clearly when things are uncertain. You raise standards and address problems directly. You build teams that trust you and take ownership of their work. You're credible in the boardroom and effective at the whiteboard.

jobs.title: CBNA Risk Management Group, Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
About Citi:

Our vision is for Citi to be the pre-eminent banking partner for institutions with cross-border needs, a global leader in wealth management and a valued personal bank in our home market.

Citi's mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We have set expectations for how we must act to bring our mission to life.

Our Leadership Principles are at the heart of what we do: We take ownership. We deliver with pride. We succeed together.

For more about Citi, please visit www.citigroup.com.

About the Group:

The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and CBNA Risk Management Group sits within Independent Risk Management in the second line of defense. ERM includes programs such as risk frameworks and policy, risk identification, risk appetite and limits, and stress testing. CBNA Risk Management includes key credit and regulatory programs that support bank-wide safety and soundness.

About the Role:

The Senior Vice President within the CBNA Risk Management team will focus primarily on portfolio credit risk management activities. This involves providing effective oversight and periodic review and challenge of first line of defense portfolio management processes and outcomes so that credit risk is effectively managed, protecting Citi’s financial stability and support safety and soundness while supporting overall business strategy.

Key Responsibilities
:

Lead second line of defense oversight and review of key bank credit and regulatory programs, focused initially on an intra-firm credit instrument program. This program enables bank legal entities to efficiently manage their capital while meeting local regulatory requirements related to concentrations of credit. Risk management activities include:
Providing independent review and challenge and recommending required approvals within the program. This includes reviewing requests from the first line of defense for extensions of credit under the program and periodic limit / program approvals.
Overseeing and monitoring portfolio health, leveraging portfolio reporting and engagement with internal stakeholders. Developing improvements to portfolio monitoring and escalation tools and routines for proactive risk management.
Partnering with internal stakeholders for improved connectivity between bank credit and regulatory programs and business-as-usual risk management, inclusive of operating models, limit methodologies, reporting and technology, and governance and controls.
Support other bank credit and regulatory programs as needed, which include limit and portfolio management activities, driving governance discussions, monitoring risk mitigation efforts, and supporting deal-based limit and program assessments so that risk-taking remains within approved risk appetite and other constraints.

Promote and drive a strong governance control environment supporting bank credit and regulatory programs. This includes:
Driving adherence to firm policies, processes, and controls aligned to regulatory requirements, inclusive of designing and implementing enhancement opportunities.
Supporting compliance, internal audit, and regulatory engagements that touch in-scope bank credit and regulatory programs.
Embed Citi’s risk culture throughout day-to-day activities as an individual contributor. This includes being an enthusiastic and early adopter of change, proactively identifying opportunities to streamline work, and taking accountability for identifying, escalating, and managing potential risks in a proactive way.

Qualifications
:

10+ years of experience, preferably in a credit-related role and with an understanding of banking regulation regarding key risk management and control concepts.
Solid knowledge and hands-on experience in risk management, especially with credit portfolios, inclusive of risk assessment, credit analysis, and portfolio monitoring.
Prompt and efficient in responding to ad-hoc transaction requests with a keen ability to identify, mitigate and challenge trade-specific risks and forecast potential risk scenarios.
Skilled communicator with the ability to explain complex financial concepts and risks for stakeholders and to document review and challenge accordingly.
Strong project management skills, with the capability to oversee multiple projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Education
:

Bachelor's degree required. Master's degree preferred. Focus areas may include finance, economics, business administration.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. jobs.title: Sr Director RSM Marketing
jobs.description:
We are committed to connecting Canadians through unique partnerships, our world-class network and content Canadians love—and our innovative team is growing. We are looking for dedicated team members to join our Corporate team who have a genuine passion for making positive impacts on customers and the communities where we live and work. We have a variety of business units with exciting and meaningful work waiting for you, including Communications, HR, Legal and Corporate Affairs, Supply Chain, Finance, and Real Estate. If you are considering your next step, we have exciting opportunities waiting for you. Come build a rewarding career at Rogers and be a driving force behind our success story!

Who We Are Looking For

The Senior Director, Marketing, is the portfolio marketing leader for Rogers Sports & Media, responsible for building audiences, accelerating subscription growth and strengthening the market leadership of our consumer brands. This role sets the integrated brand and go-to-market agenda across the full Sportsnet portfolio, television and specialty brands, streaming products and services, and Rogers’ national radio network of 40+ stations.

Leading a team of 15+ marketers, the Senior Director translates audience insight, content priorities and business goals into distinctive brand platforms, full-funnel marketing plans, partner programs and high-impact advertising. The role works across a complex matrix of content, product, distribution, revenue, media, insights, creative and agency partners to deliver measurable growth and consistent brand experiences across every audience touchpoint.

What You'll Do

Sports The full Sportsnet portfolio, including linear channels, digital platforms, audio, social, direct-to-consumer products and priority league, team and event properties.
Television and specialty Entertainment brands and services across broadcast, specialty, digital and on-demand environments.
Streaming Owned DTC products and partner-distributed OTT offerings across web, apps, connected television and third-party platforms.
Radio Portfolio marketing support for Rogers’ network of 40+ stations, strengthening local relevance while leveraging national scale
Grow audiences across platforms Increase reach, consideration, tune-in, engagement and frequency across linear, digital, audio, social and streaming platforms by connecting priority content with clearly defined audience and fan segments.
Accelerate DTC and OTT subscription growth Build integrated acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and win-back programs that grow paid subscriptions, improve customer lifetime value and reduce churn across owned services and third-party partner networks.
Maximize partner-distributed growth Develop scalable joint marketing, merchandising and promotional programs with BDU, connected-TV, device and streaming partners to expand discovery, conversion and usage.
Protect and extend market leadership Maintain strong leadership positions for Rogers Sports & Media brands in every market in which they operate through differentiated positioning, consistent brand stewardship, local relevance and disciplined competitive response.
Improve marketing effectiveness Establish clear portfolio KPIs, measurement frameworks and optimization routines that connect marketing investment to audience, subscriber, revenue and brand outcomes.
Build one high-performing portfolio team Create a clear operating model, shared standards and an inclusive performance culture that strengthens capabilities, develops talent and improves speed, quality and accountability.
Portfolio Strategy and Brand Leadership Set the multi-year portfolio marketing strategy and annual integrated marketing roadmap, aligning audience, subscriber, revenue and brand objectives across Sportsnet, television, streaming and radio.
Define and steward brand promises, positioning, architectures, identities and customer experiences, ensuring each brand is distinctive while contributing to the strength of Rogers Sports & Media and Rogers.
Translate consumer, fan, cultural and market insight into prioritized growth opportunities, audience segments and go-to-market plans.
Guide brand and product alignment across content, platforms and distribution models, ensuring a consistent experience from awareness through consumption and loyalty.
Act as a senior marketing advisor to business and content leaders, bringing a portfolio view to investment choices, market opportunities and competitive challenges.
Audience and Subscriber Growth Lead always-on and tentpole marketing strategies that grow audiences for priority sports, shows, personalities, stations, franchises and platforms.
Own the marketing strategy across the customer lifecycle, including awareness, consideration, acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, churn reduction and reactivation.
Partner with product, analytics and revenue teams to improve conversion, engagement, retention and lifetime value across DTC and OTT products.
Develop channel and platform merchandising strategies that improve content discovery and consumption across owned and partner environments.
Build joint business and marketing plans with distribution partners, including BDUs, OTT aggregators, connected-TV platforms, device ecosystems and other strategic partners.
Cultivate league, team, talent, content and commercial partnerships that expand reach, deepen fan engagement and create differentiated audience experiences.
Integrated Marketing, Advertising and Creative Excellence
Lead development of full-funnel marketing plans and advertising calendars across paid, owned, earned, social, experiential, partnership, CRM and on-platform channels.
Set clear strategic briefs and creative standards that inspire distinctive, effective work and support consistent brand delivery across the portfolio.
Oversee campaign development from insight and briefing through media, production, launch, optimization and post-campaign evaluation.
Balance national portfolio priorities with the local market needs of radio stations and regional brands.
Partner closely with internal creative, media agency partners, communications and production teams, as well as external vendors and partners, to deliver work efficiently and at a high standard.
Identify emerging platforms, technologies and marketing approaches that can improve audience experience, marketing effectiveness and speed to market.
Own portfolio marketing budgets and resource planning, directing investment toward the highest-value audience, subscriber and brand opportunities.
Establish annual objectives, benchmarks, scorecards and tactical targets across brand health, audience, subscription, engagement, retention and campaign performance.
Create a disciplined test-and-learn approach, using audience, product and campaign data to optimize investment and improve future planning.
Streamline briefs, governance, approvals and campaign workflows to increase clarity, accountability, speed and operational efficiency.
Build common marketing practices, tools and planning frameworks that can be leveraged across brands, products and business units.
Maintain strong agency, vendor and platform relationships while ensuring appropriate commercial discipline, quality and performance.
Lead, coach and develop a diverse team of 15+ marketing professionals, setting clear priorities, decision rights and performance expectations.
Build succession strength and provide meaningful development opportunities that expand strategic, digital, commercial and leadership capabilities.
Create an environment of collaboration, curiosity, inclusion, accountability and high performance.
Influence across senior and cross-functional teams, aligning content, product, distribution, sales, revenue, insights, media and creative partners around shared outcomes.
Champion customer- and audience-first thinking throughout Rogers Sports & Media.

Measures of Success

Audience growth across priority linear, streaming, digital, audio and social platforms.
Net DTC and partner-distributed subscription growth, supported by stronger acquisition efficiency, engagement and retention.
Improved content discovery, tune-in, usage and frequency across owned and partner platforms.
Sustained or improved market leadership and brand health across sports, television, streaming and radio brands.
Clear contribution of marketing to revenue, customer lifetime value and portfolio growth.
Higher marketing effectiveness through stronger measurement, optimized media investment and more efficient operating practices.
A high-performing, engaged team with strong talent development, succession depth and cross-functional reputation.

Experience And Qualifications

Progressive senior marketing leadership experience (15+ years) in media, entertainment, sports, streaming, subscription, technology or another complex consumer business.
Demonstrated success leading a multi-brand or multi-product portfolio and translating business strategy into integrated marketing action.
Strong understanding of the Canadian media environment, audience behaviour, sports fandom, broadcast marketing and the evolving streaming ecosystem.
Proven experience driving audience growth and subscription outcomes across DTC and partner-distributed channels.
Expertise in brand strategy, portfolio management, audience segmentation, full-funnel marketing, performance media, CRM and lifecycle marketing.
Demonstrated ability to use brand, product, audience and campaign analytics to make investment decisions and optimize performance.
Experience leading sizable teams and developing next-generation marketing talent.
Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization and build trusted relationships with senior executives, content leaders, product teams, partners and agencies.
Strong commercial acumen, including budget ownership, vendor management, prioritization and resource allocation.
Exceptional strategic thinking, communication and executive presentation skills, paired with a bias for action and executional excellence.

Leadership Profile

Audience-obsessed Deeply curious about what makes Canadians watch, listen, subscribe, engage and return.
Enterprise-minded Sees connections across brands and platforms and makes choices for the strength of the total portfolio.
Growth-oriented Combines brand-building ambition with performance discipline and commercial accountability.
Creatively ambitious Raises the quality and distinctiveness of the work while remaining focused on measurable outcomes.
Data-led Uses evidence to sharpen strategy, accelerate learning and improve decisions without losing human insight.
Collaborative and influential Brings diverse partners together, creates clarity and moves complex work forward.
People-first Sets a high bar, coaches with intention and creates opportunities for others to grow.

Key Relationships

Internal

Rogers Sports & Media senior leadership; Sportsnet, Television/Streaming and Radio business and content leaders; Brand, Creative, Media, Communications, Product, Technology, Distribution, Revenue, Sales, Insights, Analytics, Finance and People teams.

External

Media agencies; league, team, talent and content partners; BDU and OTT platform partners; production and technology vendors; and strategic commercial partners.

What’s in It for You?

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts and perks, including

Competitive salary and annual bonus.
Competitive and flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA and stock matching programs.
Discounts Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers services and Blue Jays tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
Paid time off for volunteering.
Company matching contributions to charities you support.

jobs.title: Adobe Alliance Sales Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, we solve complex business challenges and deliver growth through strategic alliances. Within the EMEA Alliances Impact Center, we work with leading technology partners to bring differentiated, market-relevant solutions to clients. Adobe is a key strategic alliance, helping PwC deliver transformative customer, marketing and digital experience solutions across the region.

About The Role

The Adobe Alliance Sales Director is a pivotal, deal-focused leadership role responsible for shaping and driving the strategic Adobe alliance proposition across the EMEA market, with a primary focus on the UK. This role is accountable for driving measurable revenue growth by translating Adobe’s go-to-market strategy, solutions portfolio, including Adobe Experience Cloud, and partner ecosystem into a compelling and scalable PwC market proposition.

This is a senior, outcomes-driven leadership role with clear accountability for materially growing Adobe-related revenue across the region. The role requires operating with influence at C suite level, both internally and with Adobe, in a highly matrixed alliance environment. The role is central to building pipeline, increasing win rates, strengthening senior client relationships, and growing internal advocacy and adoption of Adobe-led solutions. Working closely with PwC practice teams, network firms and Adobe leadership, the role carries end-to-end accountability for alliance performance, including pipeline creation, revenue growth, sales conversion, team effectiveness and investment priorities.

What Your Days Will Look Like

Leading Go-To-Market Strategy
Design, execute, and manage the Adobe alliance strategy and business plan, with a strong focus on market penetration and revenue growth
Partner with sales and delivery teams to generate qualified pipeline, increase deal flow, and accelerate sales cycles
Collaborate with Adobe and internal leadership to identify and develop high-impact joint solutions aligned to firm and Adobe strategic priorities
Clearly articulate the Adobe value proposition internally and externally, aligning opportunities with Adobe capabilities
Build and maintain senior relationships within Adobe (e.g. Alliance leadership, sales leaders, C-suite stakeholders) as a strategic point of contact
Identify new areas of collaboration between Adobe and the firm to expand the alliance footprint
Work cross-sector and cross-service to embed Adobe-led propositions into broader transformation programmes
Act as a strategic advisor on Adobe capabilities and opportunities to firm leadership
Lead annual and ongoing joint planning sessions with Adobe to ensure alignment and drive growth
Ensure required Adobe partner accreditations and certifications are achieved and maintained
Proactively influence internal prioritisation of Adobe opportunities to ensure appropriate focus and investment
Driving Revenue Growth
Own accountability for material year-on-year growth in Adobe-related pipeline and revenue
Identify and progress "sell-with" opportunities jointly with Adobe across target accounts
Lead commercial aspects of the Adobe partnership, including funding programmes, referrals, and joint investments
Align target clients and strategic opportunities with Adobe account teams
Define and execute winning strategies for priority deals
Engage Adobe subject matter experts where needed to strengthen propositions and support deal qualification
Drive demand generation activities in collaboration with Adobe and internal teams
Work closely with client teams to qualify, shape, and scope opportunities, contributing to solution development
Support forecasting and pipeline tracking across Adobe-related opportunities
Provide direction to sales teams to align with Adobe strategy across key accounts
Lead and support joint marketing campaigns to differentiate offerings and generate incremental revenue
Provide market insights and client intelligence through the lens of Adobe capabilities
Engage directly with clients alongside account teams to shape and progress opportunities
Support and participate in client presentations ("orals") and key deal discussions
Advise on proposal development, Statements of Work, and commercial structuring
Identify and develop client success stories, case studies, and reference materials
Operational Leadership & Governance
Oversee execution of the Adobe alliance plan across the firm
Track and communicate progress against objectives, addressing risks and driving corrective actions where needed
Actively identify underperformance risks and intervene early to protect revenue outcomes
Own and maintain the Adobe relationship map across stakeholders
Ensure compliance with all alliance governance and contractual requirements
Oversee reporting on key performance metrics (pipeline, revenue, win rates, funding utilisation)
Manage the Adobe alliance budget, ensuring effective and strategic allocation of resources
Ensure appropriate commercial agreements and contracts are in place with Adobe

This Role Is For You If

Proven, personal sales leadership track record within the Adobe ecosystem, across Adobe Enterprise Digital Marketing Solutions
Strong communication and leadership abilities
Experience in complex, matrixed organisations and stakeholder management
Motivational skills and adaptability
Commercial acumen and risk awareness
Influencing, negotiating, and facilitation skills
Awareness of emerging industry trends and curiosity
Comfortable operating at Csuite level, challenging both internal leaders and Adobe counterparts to unlock growth
Thrives in ambiguity and is energised by building momentum where none exists

What You’ll Receive From Us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

Manages complex client sales inquiries related to product offerings, pricing, and implementation, ensuring clear communication and timely responses to facilitate the sales process.
Conducts sales discussions, introducing innovative products and services, sharing insights on industry trends, and fostering proactive client engagement.
Promotes new business opportunities by building client relationships, cross-selling treasury solutions, and leveraging external networks.
Coordinates deal closures by collaborating with internal teams, external stakeholders, and clients to ensure agreements are finalized effectively and in compliance with organizational standards.
Ensures the accuracy of documentation for cash management services, reviewing service agreements and maintaining compliance with internal policies and guidelines.

Serves as a subject matter expert to stakeholders, addressing treasury and payment-related challenges, and providing insights to improve processes and solutions.

Attends industry forums and community events, enhancing the Bank’s brand, staying updated on market trends, and leveraging insights to support sales strategies.
Builds and maintains strong long-term relationships with the bank’s high-value and strategic clients, providing strategic advice on financial solutions and ensuring exceptional service and partnership.
Analyzes client and industry data to inform customized client solution strategies that includes optimizing management of working capital.
Works closely with internal teams and stakeholders to define products, solutions and strategies that best fit clients’ needs.
Builds advocacy and adoption of the suite of industry leading NA TPS digital products & solutions.

Ensures adherence to regulatory requirements, internal controls, and compliance, mitigating risk and maintaining service standards.
Focus is primarily on business/group within BMO; may have broader, enterprise-wide focus.
Provides specialized consulting, analytical and technical support.

Deep knowledge and technical proficiency gained through extensive education and business experience.

Structuring Deals

jobs.title: Director of IT
jobs.description:
Guru Studio is a creative-driven entertainment company and an industry leader in animated storytelling. For over twenty years, our studio has brought to life some of the most recognizable and beloved children’s properties in the world.

We’re always looking for passionate and committed talent, so come join our dynamic and growing team!

Guru is proud to offer our team members meaningful learning and developmental opportunities! You will work alongside a wide range of talent in a positive and supportive environment where we want to see success in each individual.

We're looking for a talented and experienced Director of IT - come join our team!

The Director of IT will supervise and manage the IT department’s daily and long-term operations to allow for growth in a fast paced and rapidly expanding internationally renowned animation studio. This role is a management position for a very sophisticated tech-based company and requires clear and effective leadership and visionary thinking. This role reports to the VP of Technology.

Duties and Responsibilities include but will not be limited to:

Management + Supervision

Manage a department of IT professionals in their day to day operational functions and all of their responsibilities including server, desktop, and communications infrastructure, ensuring a reasonable level of in-studio IT support is available during regular business hours.
Set goals and milestones for all IT staff. Review their performance and report to the VP of Technology.
Liaise with all heads of production and business operations to ensure IT department’s efforts are coordinated to meet everyone’s needs (get information on studio upcoming projects, determine production resources needs, communication and delivery requirements and issue and follow up on all appropriate tasks).

Facility Infrastructure Planning

Ensure all physical services (leased space, electrical, HVAC, floor load etc) at the studio and in the data centre are able to support IT equipment and services and that the equipment is compatible and fully integrated with physical services.
Manage all budget needs for the IT department: create, present and revise purchase orders, follow up on approvals, ensure purchasing documentation is digitized, recorded and stored in a central repository, maintain IT inventory lists.
Budget for, acquire and maintain appropriate licenses for all software needed for production and business operations.
Maintain studio growth plan with the President, the VP of Technology and VP of Finance and Business Affairs.
Gather and organize purchasing research with guidance from relevant IT personnel.
Prepare projected equipment cost information for studio project bidding purposes.
Implement, manage and supervise IT desktop ticketing systems.
Schedule IT all operations including: personnel, technical maintenance, internal meetings and finance and budget related deadlines.
Ensure regular maintenance and upgrades are done to all IT infrastructure to ensure a secure and well-functioning IT environment.
Work with studio stakeholders to implement any studio expansion or move.

Knowledgebase

Maintain IT documentation/wiki (oversee, coordinate and arrange information input and creation of diagrams, organize the structure of documentation/wiki, propose new sections).
Create and Maintain IT procedures and policies (coordinate with the input from the VP of Technology).
Guru methodology asks for employees who will go above and beyond; in staying informed on upcoming technologies, most cost-effective vendors and taking the initiative in implementing forward thinking planning within each department.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
5+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure and operations, including 1–2+ years in a senior management or director-level role.
Previous experience working in an animation, VFX, gaming, or post-production environment is considered a strong asset.
Deep expertise in enterprise server architecture, high-speed networking, SAN/NAS storage, render farms, cloud/hybrid workflows, and multi-OS environments (Linux, Windows, macOS).
Strong familiarity with 2D/3D creative software pipelines (e.g., Maya, Houdini, Nuke, Harmony, Adobe Creative Cloud) and managing enterprise software licensing.
Hands-on experience overseeing physical data center requirements (electrical, HVAC, floor load) and leading studio office expansions or relocations.
Proven track record managing IT helpdesk ticketing systems, asset inventories, preventative maintenance schedules, and studio security/IP protection standards (such as TPN compliance).
Extensive experience negotiating vendor contracts, managing purchase orders, and forecasting equipment costs for project bidding.
Strong organizational skills with experience building and maintaining structured IT wikis, network diagrams, SOPs, and company-wide IT policies.

We create a collaborative and creatively fulfilling work environment by promoting courage, purpose, inspiration, integrity, transparency, and empowerment as our core values

Remote – Austin, TX or Toronto, ON

Narvar is growing! We are hiring a Director, Global People Operations to lead HR and People Operations across North America and India. You will own the function, the systems, and the team that keep a fast-scaling, multi-country workforce running.

You'll deploy People Operations strategy, lead the team that runs day-to-day service delivery, and partner with senior leadership on the org and talent questions that matter at a company level. You'll lead a distributed team of 3 supporting US, Canadian, and Indian based employees.

What You'll Own

Lead the Global People Operations function and team
Work with the Exec Team to set the strategy and operating standards for People Operations across North America and India, and build a function that scales with the business.
Manage, coach, and develop a distributed team of three across multiple time zones and regions. Own hiring, leveling, and succession within People Operations, and raise the bar on how the team delivers in both regions.
Own service delivery across North America and India
Be accountable for People Ops service delivery across regions (HRIS and people systems, onboarding and offboarding, and the full employee lifecycle), with your team running day-to-day execution.
Set consistent, documented processes that work the same way in all regions, and keep policy, documentation, and records accurate and accessible.
Modernize the function by bringing AI and automation to employee data, reporting, and routine operations to reduce manual work and improve accuracy.
Own multi-region compliance, risk, and employee relations
Be accountable for statutory and employment-law compliance in India (Shops & Establishments Act, POSH Act, Provident Fund, ESI, Gratuity, Professional Tax, and state-specific regulations) and across North America (US and Canadian federal, state, and provincial employment law).
Partner with legal, payroll, and external consultants in each region, own relationships with statutory bodies and auditors, and oversee POSH Internal Committee responsibilities.
Serve as the senior escalation point for employee relations and workplace investigations, ensuring fair, timely, and locally compliant resolution.
Partner with leadership on org and talent strategy
Act as a strategic people partner to senior and functional leadership, advising on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy at a company level.
Guide leadership effectiveness and organizational health, and support reorgs and scale-ups as a change partner.
Bring people data and analytics (attrition, engagement, span/layer, representation) to leadership as insight-led recommendations, not just administrative support.
Own compensation, performance, and people programs
Own the design and governance of compensation across regions, including annual reviews, equity refresh cycles, and market benchmarking (including India-market benchmarking against local tech and GCC employers).
Own the frameworks for performance, leveling, and engagement, and set the cadence the team runs them on.
Shape and localize global people programs, including engagement surveys, career frameworks, recognition, and total rewards.

The North America and India people teams operate as one function, with consistent, documented processes across regions.
Statutory compliance run clean in both regions, with zero major findings.
Senior leaders view you as a trusted partner, not only as a transactional HR contact.
Clear, consistent frameworks for leveling, performance, and compensation are in place across regions.
Engagement and attrition metrics improve year-over-year.

12–15+ years of progressive HR / People Operations experience in multi-country, high-growth tech environments.
People leadership: 7+ years managing and developing HR / People Ops teams, ideally across multiple regions and time zones.
Multi-region operations ownership: demonstrated accountability for People Ops (HRIS, compliance, and lifecycle) globally.
Compliance depth across regions: strong working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory requirements (including POSH) and North American (US and Canadian) employment law.
Strategic business partnering: a track record of advising and influencing senior and executive leaders on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.
Compensation and performance: experience owning comp planning, benchmarking, and performance frameworks.
Employee relations judgment: excellent judgment on investigations, with a bias for fair, timely resolution.
Systems and automation mindset: comfort modernizing People Ops with HRIS and AI/automation for employee data and reporting.
Education: bachelor's degree required; MBA or PG in HR or equivalent preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

This role directly owns Walmart US, Kroger, Publix, HEB, Trader Joe’s and Harris Teeter, leads the e-commerce channel including Amazon, and supports the Costco business in partnership with the VP of Strategic Accounts, with the long-term goal of owning the Club channel.

Build and execute customer plans that deliver sales, distribution and profit targets for each account within the approved trade budget.
Manage trade spend, the promotional calendar and pricing execution for assigned accounts, with a clear focus on trade ROI.
Develop senior-level relationships with buyers, category managers and customer leadership teams.
Use retailer POS, portal and syndicated data to identify growth opportunities and lead fact-based business reviews.

2. E-Commerce

Own the e-commerce channel, including Amazon, with accountability for sales, profitability and channel strategy.
Manage the Amazon relationship, including vendor or seller operations, assortment, pricing, promotions and advertising investment.
Drive digital shelf execution across Amazon and retailer .com sites: content, ratings and reviews, search visibility and in-stock performance.
Partner with Brand and Commercial Strategy & Insights on retail media and digital programs at strategic accounts.
Identify and evaluate new e-commerce and direct-to-consumer opportunities.

3. Costco Support & Club Channel

Partner with the VP of Strategic Accounts to support the Costco US and Canada business, including item submissions, programs and business reviews.
Work alongside the Sales & Marketing Admin Assistant on Costco admin, reporting and day-to-day account execution.
Build Club channel knowledge, buyer relationships and program expertise in preparation for taking full ownership of the Club channel.
Long term, own the Club channel, including strategy, annual plans, item and program management, and growth targets.

4. New Business Development

Build and manage the new customer and channel pipeline, with priority targets set in partnership with the SVP of Commercial.
Lead new customer pitches, new item presentations and listing negotiations from first meeting through to first order.
Evaluate new channel opportunities for strategic fit, profitability and supply capacity before committing resources.
Set new business priorities and commercial terms within the approved trade budget.
Track pipeline progress and conversion, and report new customer sales against plan.

5. Account Coverage & Operations

Shape and evolve the coverage model for assigned accounts, building direct customer relationships and internal capability over time.
Own the operating model for retailer portals, promotional planning, deductions and paperwork alongside the Sales Analyst.
Ensure flawless service, promotional execution and retailer compliance across all assigned accounts.

6. Team Leadership

Directly manage the Sales Analyst.
Provide leadership, coaching, development and performance oversight.
Build repeatable account management processes that can scale as the business grows.

7. Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Commercial Strategy & Insights on category reviews, selling stories, pricing and promotional ROI.
Provide sales input to the monthly S&OP forecast and work with S&OP and Supply Chain on promotional volumes, new item launches and service levels.
Work with Finance on trade spend, gross-to-net and customer profitability.
Partner with Brand and Product Development on innovation sell-in and launch plans for strategic accounts.
Coordinate with the Sr. Director of Sales and Directors of Sales on shared programs, national initiatives and best practices.

8. Success Measures

Strategic account and e-commerce sales vs. FY27 AOP.
New customer sales vs. plan.
Trade ROI and forecast accuracy (sales input) for assigned accounts.
Account coverage and execution standards met; Club channel transition on schedule.

9. Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics or a related field; MBA an asset.
10+ years of CPG sales experience, including direct management of one or more of Walmart US, Kroger, Publix or HEB.

jobs.title: VP Sales Lead
jobs.description:
VP sales Lead , Commercial Banking

Lead Growth. Influence Strategy. Help Businesses Thrive.

At BMO Commercial Bank, we're looking for a proven relationship management leader to drive growth across a portfolio of sophisticated commercial clients. In this role, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to business owners, executives, and key decision-makers, helping them navigate opportunities, manage risk, and achieve their long-term strategic objectives.

As a senior member of the Commercial Banking team, you'll lead complex financing transactions, champion client relationships, and play a pivotal role in expanding BMO's presence in the market. You'll work alongside industry specialists, credit partners, and senior leaders to deliver customized financial solutions that help businesses grow and succeed.

What You'll Do

Drive Business Growth

Develop and execute market growth strategies to expand BMO's commercial banking presence.
Build and deepen relationships with high-value clients and prospective businesses.
Identify new business opportunities and grow market share through proactive networking, referrals, and strategic relationship development.
Maximize client potential by delivering integrated banking, treasury, cash management, and lending solutions.

Lead Complex Commercial Transactions

Structure and negotiate sophisticated credit facilities and financial solutions.
Lead high-value financing opportunities from initial discussion through approval and closing.
Partner with credit, risk, and product teams to deliver tailored solutions that meet client objectives while maintaining sound risk practices.
Act as the primary client advocate throughout the transaction process.

Serve as a Trusted Strategic Advisor

Build lasting relationships with business owners, executives, and industry leaders.
Provide strategic guidance on financing structures, growth opportunities, acquisitions, succession planning, and capital needs.
Monitor industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging opportunities to deliver valuable insights to clients.
Resolve complex client issues while maintaining exceptional client experience and engagement.

Collaborate Across the Enterprise

Work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional partners to deliver holistic solutions.
Leverage the full capabilities of BMO to support client growth and strengthen relationships.
Represent BMO within the business community, industry associations, and market events.

Lead and Develop High-Performing Teams

Inspire, coach, and develop a team of banking professionals.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and performance-driven culture.
Support talent development, succession planning, and employee growth.
Lead through change and help teams adapt to evolving client and market needs.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of experience in Commercial Banking, Corporate Banking, Relationship Management, or a comparable client-facing financial services environment.
Demonstrated success managing and growing complex commercial client portfolios.
Strong commercial credit expertise, including structuring, negotiating, and underwriting complex financing transactions.
Proven business development track record and ability to build trusted executive-level relationships.
Strong leadership experience with demonstrated success coaching and developing talent.
Deep understanding of financial analysis, risk assessment, and portfolio management.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Why Join BMO?

Manage sophisticated client relationships and impactful commercial transactions.
Influence business growth strategies across a dynamic market.
Collaborate with industry-leading banking professionals and specialists.
Access meaningful career development and leadership opportunities.
Join a purpose-driven organization committed to Boldly Growing the Good in business and life.

If you're passionate about relationship management, business development, and helping Canadian businesses achieve their ambitions, we invite you to explore this opportunity with BMO Commercial Bank.

Salary:

$80,000.00 - $160,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

new_jobs.title: Adobe Alliance Sales Director
new_jobs.description:
At PwC, we solve complex business challenges and deliver growth through strategic alliances. Within the EMEA Alliances Impact Center, we work with leading technology partners to bring differentiated, market-relevant solutions to clients. Adobe is a key strategic alliance, helping PwC deliver transformative customer, marketing and digital experience solutions across the region.

About The Role

The Adobe Alliance Sales Director is a pivotal, deal-focused leadership role responsible for shaping and driving the strategic Adobe alliance proposition across the EMEA market, with a primary focus on the UK. This role is accountable for driving measurable revenue growth by translating Adobe’s go-to-market strategy, solutions portfolio, including Adobe Experience Cloud, and partner ecosystem into a compelling and scalable PwC market proposition.

This is a senior, outcomes-driven leadership role with clear accountability for materially growing Adobe-related revenue across the region. The role requires operating with influence at C suite level, both internally and with Adobe, in a highly matrixed alliance environment. The role is central to building pipeline, increasing win rates, strengthening senior client relationships, and growing internal advocacy and adoption of Adobe-led solutions. Working closely with PwC practice teams, network firms and Adobe leadership, the role carries end-to-end accountability for alliance performance, including pipeline creation, revenue growth, sales conversion, team effectiveness and investment priorities.

What Your Days Will Look Like

Leading Go-To-Market Strategy
Design, execute, and manage the Adobe alliance strategy and business plan, with a strong focus on market penetration and revenue growth
Partner with sales and delivery teams to generate qualified pipeline, increase deal flow, and accelerate sales cycles
Collaborate with Adobe and internal leadership to identify and develop high-impact joint solutions aligned to firm and Adobe strategic priorities
Clearly articulate the Adobe value proposition internally and externally, aligning opportunities with Adobe capabilities
Build and maintain senior relationships within Adobe (e.g. Alliance leadership, sales leaders, C-suite stakeholders) as a strategic point of contact
Identify new areas of collaboration between Adobe and the firm to expand the alliance footprint
Work cross-sector and cross-service to embed Adobe-led propositions into broader transformation programmes
Act as a strategic advisor on Adobe capabilities and opportunities to firm leadership
Lead annual and ongoing joint planning sessions with Adobe to ensure alignment and drive growth
Ensure required Adobe partner accreditations and certifications are achieved and maintained
Proactively influence internal prioritisation of Adobe opportunities to ensure appropriate focus and investment
Driving Revenue Growth
Own accountability for material year-on-year growth in Adobe-related pipeline and revenue
Identify and progress "sell-with" opportunities jointly with Adobe across target accounts
Lead commercial aspects of the Adobe partnership, including funding programmes, referrals, and joint investments
Align target clients and strategic opportunities with Adobe account teams
Define and execute winning strategies for priority deals
Engage Adobe subject matter experts where needed to strengthen propositions and support deal qualification
Drive demand generation activities in collaboration with Adobe and internal teams
Work closely with client teams to qualify, shape, and scope opportunities, contributing to solution development
Support forecasting and pipeline tracking across Adobe-related opportunities
Provide direction to sales teams to align with Adobe strategy across key accounts
Lead and support joint marketing campaigns to differentiate offerings and generate incremental revenue
Provide market insights and client intelligence through the lens of Adobe capabilities
Engage directly with clients alongside account teams to shape and progress opportunities
Support and participate in client presentations ("orals") and key deal discussions
Advise on proposal development, Statements of Work, and commercial structuring
Identify and develop client success stories, case studies, and reference materials
Operational Leadership & Governance
Oversee execution of the Adobe alliance plan across the firm
Track and communicate progress against objectives, addressing risks and driving corrective actions where needed
Actively identify underperformance risks and intervene early to protect revenue outcomes
Own and maintain the Adobe relationship map across stakeholders
Ensure compliance with all alliance governance and contractual requirements
Oversee reporting on key performance metrics (pipeline, revenue, win rates, funding utilisation)
Manage the Adobe alliance budget, ensuring effective and strategic allocation of resources
Ensure appropriate commercial agreements and contracts are in place with Adobe

This Role Is For You If

Proven, personal sales leadership track record within the Adobe ecosystem, across Adobe Enterprise Digital Marketing Solutions
Strong communication and leadership abilities
Experience in complex, matrixed organisations and stakeholder management
Motivational skills and adaptability
Commercial acumen and risk awareness
Influencing, negotiating, and facilitation skills
Awareness of emerging industry trends and curiosity
Comfortable operating at Csuite level, challenging both internal leaders and Adobe counterparts to unlock growth
Thrives in ambiguity and is energised by building momentum where none exists

What You’ll Receive From Us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

new_jobs.title: Region Head of CIBC Family Office for Quebec - Bilingual
new_jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll act as a trusted advisor, coordinating with internal and external specialists to deliver seamless, holistic financial solutions tailored to each UHNW client’s unique needs. In this leadership role, you’ll oversee in your region business development, client relationship management, and the integration of specialized services - such as cash management, credit structuring, investment management, estate planning, tax strategies, philanthropy, and succession planning. You’ll be accountable for growing and deepening client relationships, ensuring that every UHNW client receives the highest standard of care and expertise. Your ability to connect clients with the right CIBC channels and subject matter experts will be key to supporting their long-term financial goals, while your oversight will ensure the ongoing success and growth of the Family Office in your region.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

How You’ll Succeed

Business Development & Growth – Identify and pursue new opportunities with prospective UHNW clients, represent CIBC Family Office at industry events, and build a robust referral ecosystem with internal partners and external centers of influence. Collaborate with team’s key client advisors to align solutions with clients’ goals and risk tolerance.
Client Relationship Management - Serve as the primary point of contact for Family Office clients in your region, cultivating long-term, trust-based relationships and maintaining regular touchpoints with each client and their dedicated CIBC Family Office “deal team.” Oversee a portfolio of approximately 100 Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) client households, ensuring the achievement of strategic goals and consistently delivering exceptional service and outcomes.
Integrated Solutions Delivery – Collaborate with advisors and planners across CIBC Wealth—including Private Banking, Wood Gundy, Private Investment Counsel, Planning, Trust, and partners in CIBC Bank USA and the Caribbean—to deliver tailored liquidity, investment, and planning solutions to Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) clients. Provide ongoing oversight by monitoring and reviewing progress on strategic roadmaps for both new and existing clients, ensuring their evolving needs are met with comprehensive, integrated offerings.
Risk & Compliance Leadership - Champion a culture of risk management and compliance by upholding CIBC’s high standards for policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. Act as a trusted escalation point for complex Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) client needs, and drive operational excellence by proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen controls and streamline processes.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
You bring extensive industry expertise. You have 10+ years of frontline experience in Private Banking, Wealth Management, and/or Single/Multi Family Office, including direct accountability for funds managed growth, revenue growth and credit/risk outcomes; at least 5 years’ experience in building and maintaining relationships with UHNW clients.
You’re a certified professional. You hold one or more of the following: CFA, CIM, CFP (Certified Financial Planner), CSC and CPH, FEA, or LLPQ.
You’re a strategic relationship builder with a business development mindset. You excel at developing and deepening trust-based relationships with sophisticated clients, influencing stakeholders at all levels, and growing referral ecosystems and centres of influence (COI) networks to drive new opportunities.
You have technical and regulatory expertise. You possess a deep understanding of credit structuring, wealth planning, and risk management for Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) clients, along with advanced knowledge of AML/KYC requirements in Canada, enhanced due diligence for higher-risk clients, and best practices for validating source-of-wealth and source-of-funds.
You communicate with impact. You have exceptional client-facing communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to break down complex plans and problems into clear, accessible solutions that help both clients and your team make informed decisions.
Your influence makes a difference. You recognize that strong relationships are essential to success, and you excel at influencing across lines of business while representing CIBC with professionalism in the external market. You demonstrate exceptional judgment in risk escalation and client selection, ensuring clients feel valued, heard, and supported with timely, effective solutions.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.
You're fluent in French and English to serve our clients in the community.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

What You Need To Know

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.
You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.
We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).
We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.
